how_to_run: For each eval: copy the fixture directory to a temp dir, `git init` it, make one initial commit, then invoke the skill in that dir with the given args. The runner is an agent: check every assertion against the resulting tree and bundle, and report pass/fail per assertion. Fixtures are seeded with known defects — never edit a fixture to make an assertion pass. Note: fixtures have no cc-explorer chat corpus, so Stage 3 mining runs against an empty corpus by design — evidence confidence must degrade accordingly (see assertions).
memory_setup: Evals with `seed_memory: true` also need auto memory staged, because it lives outside the repo. After `git init` and the initial commit, resolve the memory directory the way Claude Code does for the temp repo (`~/.claude/projects/<derived>/memory/`), then MOVE — not copy — `memory-seed/` from the fixture tree to that path, so no `memory-seed/` remains in the repo. Record the resolved path and a checksum of every seeded file before the run. Delete the seeded memory directory afterward; leave any snapshot the run wrote under `~/.claude/claude-md-doctor-backups/` in place for inspection, then clean it up too. If the runner cannot write to `~/.claude/projects/`, skip the memory evals and report them skipped — do not fall back to leaving the seed inside the repo, which would test a path the skill treats as inert.

assertions: AGENTS.md enters the surface via @import expansion of the CLAUDE.md shim, is triaged at Tier 1 or higher, and a decompose pass runs; the CLAUDE.md shim itself is Tier 0 (no premature all-Tier-0 fast exit)
A bundle directory exists under .claude/claude-md-doctor/<timestamp>/ containing triage.md, decompose.md, proposed-changes.md, metadata.json, and execution-report.md
The truth check catches the fast-draft.ini vs draft-fast.ini filename drift and cites it as evidence
The truth check catches the plotbot.local vs plotbot.lan hostname drift; the stale .local value appears in no kept or relocated content
The ASCII File Structure tree, the Git Workflow section, and the duplicated Troubleshooting section are gated apply:auto and are absent from the resulting AGENTS.md
The DO-NOT guardrail block (no GRBL, no multi-pen), the stop-the-server-before-editing rule, and the Scope section survive in the resulting AGENTS.md
Every pointer stub left in AGENTS.md carries concrete facts (a name, value, or command) before its link — no bare 'See <file>' stubs
At least one move is gated apply:ask, remains unchecked in proposed-changes.md, and its content is unchanged in the tree

With no chat corpus, no move's evidence line claims 'confirmed scar tissue' from mining alone — structural evidence (duplication, discoverability, staleness) or a 'suspected' downgrade is cited instead

Any move routed to a skill/hook/path-scoped-rule mechanism has a drafted artifact under the bundle's scaffolds/ directory (SKILL.md with name + trigger description, hook JSON, or rule file with paths: frontmatter), is gated apply:ask, and nothing is installed outside the bundle
Nothing is committed: git log still shows only the initial commit, and the working tree is dirty with the applied edits
AGENTS.md (the decomposed file) carries the last-decomposed marker at its top; execution-report.md reports before/after line counts and lists every new file the run created, bundle included
